entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is called the airlock area... Wait, does[n]that mean we have to go out into space!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Putting it lightly, I believe such an action[n]would lead to our extermination.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wellllll, apparently you'll be okay for like[n]thirty seconds if you keep your eyes and[n]mouth shut.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Which is weird, because honestly,[n]I woulda thought we'd just explode[n]out there.
